about: A daily series at 17:00 Los Angeles (00:00 UTC the next day); one day deleted; the series made all-day with the answer of its master write lost; Finish; then the delete undone by its entry. The change carried the day's skip to its new key and changed nothing of it, so the undo is never refused as stale: it lands on its own day, or, where the record does not say which day the entry's instant named, is refused as not undoable with nothing written or sent (x-undo-fields). From seed 61349 case 359.
